# AI disclosure

Palimpsest was built with **Claude**, an AI model made by Anthropic, in a series of conversations with the author (GitHub: [barthelemyr](https://github.com/barthelemyr)) in October 2026.

## Who did what

**Generated by Claude**
- All code: the single-page site (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and the Python scripts that process the data.
- The visual and interaction design.
- The data processing: projecting and packing the Cliopatria borders, overlaying them on today's countries, matching HYDE population to countries and states, building the density layer.
- The curated timeline content: period names, dates (standard chronology), descriptions, the choice of capitals, the approximate locations of peoples and unmapped states, short map labels, and the Wikipedia titles linked from panels.
- The project notes in `docs/notes.md`.

**By the author**
- The idea, the direction and every decision about what to build, change or remove.
- Testing, review and feedback at each step, including an external methodology review whose recommendations were applied (clearer wording about computed overlaps, provenance badges, population per state only from the HYDE grid).
- Downloading and supplying the HYDE 3.3 data.

**From published sources** (not generated)
- Historical borders (Cliopatria), population (HYDE 3.3), coastlines and today's borders (Natural Earth), flags and continent lists. See [DATA-LICENSES.md](DATA-LICENSES.md).

## What this means for readers

- AI-generated content can contain mistakes. Anything marked **Editorial** in the site has not been checked against a specific reference; **✓ Checked** entries have.
- Locations marked **Approximate** were placed by hand by the AI and have not yet been verified.
- Figures marked **Computed** come from this project's own processing of published data, with the method described in each panel's *Source and method* section.
- The site itself says so in its About panel ("Made with Claude").

If you find an error, please open an issue: corrections are part of the point of publishing this prototype.
